class.name: HPAAgentNode
class.brief_description: Abstract agent endpoint for a single parallel environment. Subclass this in GDScript to implement your environment logic.
class.description: Place exactly one subclass of [HPAAgentNode] inside your environment scene. [HPAMasterNode] locates it automatically and calls its methods each physics step to collect observations, retrieve rewards, and apply actions received from Python. Override [method _get_scalar_obs_size] and [method _get_action_size] to declare the size of your observation and action spaces in bytes. These are queried once at startup and must remain constant for the lifetime of the node. Override the per-step callbacks to implement your environment's logic.

method.name: get_env_index
method.description: Returns the zero-based index of this environment instance, assigned by [HPAMasterNode] during startup. Use it to, for example, offset random seeds so parallel environments are not identical: [codeblock] var rng = RandomNumberGenerator.new() rng.seed = base_seed + get_env_index() [/codeblock]

method.name: _get_scalar_obs_size
method.description: Return the size in bytes of the scalar observation vector written by [method _collect_scalar_obs]. Must be constant for the lifetime of the node.

method.name: _get_action_size
method.description: Return the size in bytes of the action vector passed to [method _apply_action]. Must be constant for the lifetime of the node.

method.name: _collect_scalar_obs
method.description: Return the scalar observations for the current step as raw bytes. The length must equal [method _get_scalar_obs_size].

method.name: _apply_action
method.description: Decode [param action] and apply it to the environment. Called once per physics step after Python responds with actions.

method.name: _get_reward
method.description: Return the reward earned during this step.

method.name: _get_episode_state
method.description: Return the current episode state. Return [constant TERMINATED] when the episode ends naturally (goal reached, failure, etc.) or [constant TRUNCATED] when it ends artificially (time limit, out-of-bounds guard, etc.). Return [constant RUNNING] otherwise. [HPAMasterNode] reads this each step and automatically resets the environment before collecting the next observation when the state is not [constant RUNNING], so [method _reset] will always be called before the next [method _collect_scalar_obs].

method.name: _reset
method.description: Reset the environment to its initial state for a new episode. Called automatically by [HPAMasterNode] whenever [method _get_episode_state] returns a non-[constant RUNNING] value. Must also clear the episode state back to [constant RUNNING] so the next step is collected correctly.

constants.constant: The episode is ongoing. Normal operation.
The episode ended naturally: the agent reached its goal, failed, or otherwise reached a terminal state defined by the environment logic.
The episode ended artificially: a time limit expired, the agent left the valid region, or some other external condition cut the episode short.
